round: the round after tester round 13 (verdict fail at 9aed5df8; red test e2e88a97)
design: Chose the architect's preferred design: the Dispatch decision record no longer runs inside the tool_call handler. handleCall appends the advisor-gate entry (main's record-failure refusal kept), keeps the override comment, mints, delivers notices and returns; the record then starts in the background under its own RECORD_TIMEOUT_MS stop, tracked in a pending set that session_shutdown waits for and cuts at its record deadline before markers are released. Oh My Pi's appendEntry stays open until shutdown seals the session, so a record that fails, hits its stop or is cut lands as a follow-up entry of the new type advisor-gate-record {toolCallId, tool, recordError} and a runtimeLogger line; askgate-report.ts reads only advisor-gate entries, so its counts are unchanged. CEILING_MARGIN_MS is main's 5,000 ms again, so the review deadline at the default 30 s ceiling is 25,000 ms and the minimum ceiling 15,000 ms. Bounding the record by the remaining budget was not needed, so no count is cut by the review's time.

proof.criterion: At the default 30 s ceiling the review keeps main's 25,000 ms deadline (red test e2e88a97), and the Dispatch record still lands.
